description: Functional scope: associate AIProviderCredential with canonical Connect.Credential and add explicit auth_kind none semantics; no empty-key inference. No-auth is disabled policy, grantless, non-personal and resolves explicit no-auth authentication. Extend atomic :remove validation only for explicit no-auth+disabled. Tests first: FK/deletion constraints, invalid policy/grant combinations, no-auth resolver matrix/property tests, atomic authenticated-to-no-auth transition/rollback, clock/expiry regressions. Mocking: real Repo. Docs: Engine/System config. Action reuse: extend Connect.Mutations, CredentialResolver and existing AI schema; no new Action because schema invariants/resolution are local domain contracts.
title: AI credential Connect association and explicit no-auth
